principle: AI can find and normalize external diet/workout ideas, but imported plans must pass license, attribution, safety, and user-confirmation gates before activation.

workflow_steps.name: User search
workflow_steps.description: User asks for a plan, e.g. beginner 5km, pregnancy mobility, keto meal schedule, yoga for back pain.

workflow_steps.name: Search web/server sources
workflow_steps.description: Backend searches approved sources and returns citations/source URLs. Do not copy paywalled/protected plans wholesale.

workflow_steps.name: Normalize into internal schema
workflow_steps.description: AI converts result into plan days, sessions, exercises, nutrition notes, reminders and safety flags using app-owned wording.

workflow_steps.name: License and source gate
workflow_steps.description: Store source URLs, license terms, creator, attribution, and whether commercial app use is allowed.

workflow_steps.name: Safety gate
workflow_steps.description: Pregnancy, baby, child, teen, medical, injury, eating disorder, severe restriction and advanced training get hard warnings and professional review flags.

workflow_steps.name: User preview
workflow_steps.description: Show plan summary, calendar schedule, risks, source links, equipment, diet assumptions and edit controls before importing.

workflow_steps.name: Import plan
workflow_steps.description: Create user_plan, plan_days, scheduled calendar items and history records. Keep original imported draft version.

workflow_steps.name: Activate or pause
workflow_steps.description: User can activate, pause, share, duplicate, edit, archive or delete anytime.

workflow_steps.name: History tracking
workflow_steps.description: Log what was scheduled, completed, skipped, edited, swapped and deleted.
